summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by checking the `evaluate` flag before raising an error for imaginary coordinates, but it may introduce behavioral changes and lacks additional tests.

issues.description: The change might alter the behavior of the `Point` class when `evaluate` is set to `False`, potentially affecting other parts of the codebase that rely on this behavior.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the new behavior, especially for cases where `evaluate` is `False` and coordinates are imaginary.
